descriptions.normal: A very small cake nestled within a Bulle Fruit skin. Pour the beaten egg whites into a Bulle Fruit skin that has been scraped empty, and bake it until the souffle has evenly expanded. The word "Bulle" isn't a part of the name just because it's in the ingredient list, but because the finished product allows the tongue to delight in bubble-like spongy softness.
descriptions.suspicious: A very small cake nestled within a Bulle Fruit skin. You could not resist sneaking a peek as this baked, only to see the expanding souffle collapse speedily... It seems that curiosity not only kills cats, but ruins cakes too.
descriptions.delicious: A very small cake nestled within a Bulle Fruit skin. It all starts with that glorious, fluffy mouthfeel. Then comes the rich eggy aroma and fruity-fresh flavor suffusing your mouth, as if you had plunged headfirst into pillowy clouds, such that the very air sings with subtle sweetness.
